notes.title: In the Same Boat is a French Indie Game Cup Finalist !
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

In the Same Boat is one of the four finalists of the French Indie Game Cup !
You can vote for the game [url=https://www.lagamecup.com/presentation-des-projets-newbie/]on this website[/url], by clicking on the "Je vote pour ce jeu" button above the teaser (it takes around 10 seconds)

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44547588/5ff2b93c77f7d16897f24d0bdad930e246dfe8d9.png[/img]

Every vote counts, and it may genuinely help the game get funded.

Thank you for your time,

V.
